capabilities.text: Boulevard's Admin API has a bookingCreate mutation that creates a booking
Boulevard's Client API provides cart.getBookableDates() and cart.getBookableTimes(date) methods to check availability

headline: A custom AI receptionist that works with Boulevard.

howItWorks.body: Boulevard's API includes a method to check bookable dates and times, and a mutation to create a booking. Prestique connects the agent to Boulevard's API so it can work within what that API allows. The agent only does what Boulevard's API allows and what you have approved it to do.
howItWorks.title: Booking through Boulevard

howItWorks.body: Booking follows your own rules, such as your hours, your capacity, and what the agent won't do. Anything the agent shouldn't handle goes to your team with a summary of the call.
howItWorks.title: Your rules, your limits

howItWorks.body: Every call is recorded with a transcript and a summary of what the caller needed. The agent can follow up by text message after a call.
howItWorks.title: Every call logged, follow-up sent

intro: Prestique builds custom AI voice and text agents for small businesses. The agent answers calls when your team can't, including after hours and when the line is busy.
You keep Boulevard. The agent works with it rather than replacing it. You control what the agent says and does, and changes are made when you ask for them.
